items.title: The Wade Christofferson Scandal: What Did Mormon Leaders Know?
items.summary: Mormon Discussions' episode, per its description, has host Bill Reel interviewing Chicago Sun-Times investigative reporter Robert Herguth about his reporting on Wade Christofferson, the brother of apostle D. Todd Christofferson, and how church leaders handled allegations against him. The description says it distinguishes documented findings, survivor accounts and unanswered questions.

items.title: Jana Riess: New documentary shows how dirty sodas are quirky and unmistakably LDS
items.summary: In a Religion News Service column published by The Salt Lake Tribune, Jana Riess writes that the new documentary "Saints + Sodas" ties Utah's dirty-soda culture to the church's Word of Wisdom and to members' shifting attitudes toward caffeinated soda. The film's director, Madison Pope, is quoted in the column.

items.title: I'm *DONE* with Bible Scholar Dan McClellan (Here's Why)
items.summary: Mormon News Roundup's episode says it is unsubscribing from Bible scholar Dan McClellan after he wrote that he pays tithing to the church, and urges viewers to do the same. It also discusses the church's legal campaign against the host.

items.title: Fairview mayor says time to move on from temple dispute as LDS church expands
items.summary: The Dallas Morning News reports that the Fairview mayor says it is time for the town to move on from its yearslong dispute over the Latter-day Saint temple as the church expands in North Texas.

items.title: Episode 170: The Railroad Comes to Town
items.summary: Sunstone's podcast hosts Lindsay Hansen Park and Bryan Buchanan examine the arrival of the transcontinental railroad in Utah, including unpaid Mormon laborers, ZCMI boycotts, excommunications and Brigham Young's reaction.

items.title: BYU rallies around Bear Bachmeier following four-interception loss at Utah
items.summary: FOX 13 reports BYU quarterback Bear Bachmeier is facing criticism after a difficult outing in the Cougars' second loss of the season at Utah, while teammates and coaches continue to support him.
